note: Strike Lab (issue #3; V0.1 was D190): arcade puzzle bowling. Only the committed puzzle answers are evidence; the practice ball, aim, power, spin, rolls, pins down, retries, GUIDED SHOT and MOVE ON never are.

lines.intro: Earn your shots in the Strike Lab! Solve the puzzle, then knock down the glowing pins.
lines.practiceAsk: Start with a free warm-up throw. Try aim, power and spin, then BOWL!
lines.practiceDone: Nice warm-up! Now earn your shot.
lines.smartAsk: The Smart Ball needs {needed} power. It has {present}. Which module powers it up?
lines.smartWrong: That makes {total}. It needs {needed}. Try another module.
lines.smartReady: Powered up! Knock down the glowing pin.
lines.targetAsk: Make {target} with two pins. Tap two pins.
lines.targetWrong: {a} and {b} make {sum}. We need {target}. Try another pair.
lines.targetReady: Target locked! Knock down the glowing pins.
lines.fresh: New numbers! Take a fresh look.
lines.dotsTarget: Count the dots on the pins.
lines.showMe: Here it is. Tap the shining one.
lines.showPins: Here they are. Tap the shining pins.
lines.gutter: Gutter ball! Try a new aim.
lines.secondBall: Second ball! Go for the glowing pins.
lines.targetMiss: The glowing pins are still up!
lines.guidedOffer: Want a hand? GUIDED SHOT adds rails and shows a path that works. Or move on.
lines.guidedAsk: Line up your path with the green guide, then BOWL.
lines.guidedMiss: Almost! Try the guide again, or move on.
lines.movedOn: Good bowling! On to the next one.
lines.done: Round done! Thanks for bowling in the Strike Lab.
